title: Unsupported CIP service in valid SendRRData envelope
purpose: Use a valid EtherNet/IP and CPF wrapper with an intentionally unsupported CIP service byte to reach ordinary CIP rejection logic associated with general status 0x08 Service Not Supported.
expected_behavior: The target should accept the EtherNet/IP and CPF framing and then reject the unsupported CIP service at the application layer rather than failing transport parsing.
constraints_preserved: Transport remains a valid SendRRData frame with a correct 24-byte header.
Length 0x0018 matches the command-specific bytes exactly.
The documented SendRRData CPF combination is preserved.
Unconnected Data Item length 8 matches the CIP request.
General status 0x08 Service Not Supported is cited as a possible CIP-layer outcome, not as a request operation.
issue_safety_notes: This is a safe negative-path structural seed using a valid envelope, with no malformed lengths and no issue enhancement.
